name: Cone-Beam Projection/Backprojection via B-Spline Homographies
definition: A method for cone-beam tomography that decomposes the 3D projection/backprojection into a sum of 2D homographies (planar projections) and resamples using B-spline expansions to handle variable magnification and preserve density.
summary: Cone-Beam Projection/Backprojection via B-Spline Homographies performs cone-beam tomography by decomposing 3D transforms into 2D homographies and solving for coefficients via B-spline expansions, handling variable magnification where standard methods fail.
